Term2: Cardiac implantable electronic device surgery post-op prophylaxis
Text:
# Cardiac Implantable Electronic Device (CIED) Surgery:

# *** Routine post-procedure antibiotics are not indicated. ***

# References:

Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis
in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 vol 70 pages 195-283
Krahn AD, et al. Prevention of Arrhythmia Device Infection Trial:

The PADIT Trial. Am Coll Cardiol. 2018 vol 72 pages 3098-3109
Branch-Elliman W, et al. Association of Duration and Type of Surgical
Prophylaxis With Antimicrobial-Associated Adverse Events. JAMA Surg. 2019
vol 154 pages 590-598
